title: Rockwell Automation GuardLogix/ControlLogix CIP Explicit Message Buffer Overflow
description: A remote unauthenticated attacker can send crafted Common Industrial Protocol (CIP) packets to cause a buffer overflow, allowing arbitrary code execution or unhandled controller fault (Major Non-Recoverable Fault - MNFR) in Rockwell ControlLogix and GuardLogix controllers.

title: Johnson Controls Frick Quantum HD Web Server Authentication Bypass
description: Improper authentication in the web service of the Frick Quantum HD compressor controller allows an attacker with network access to bypass credentials and modify temperature setpoints, discharge pressures, and ammonia compressor run parameters.
affected_components: Johnson Controls / Frick Quantum HD Compressor Controller

title: Siemens SIMATIC S7-1500 Remote Code Execution via S7comm-Plus Memory Corruption
description: A vulnerability in the S7comm-plus protocol implementation allows an attacker to send crafted packets to port 102/tcp resulting in memory corruption and remote code execution with complete control over CPU execution.

title: Modbus-TCP Stack Denial of Service and State Injection in Embedded Controller
description: Sending an invalid Modbus function code sequence over TCP port 502 triggers an unhandled null-pointer dereference causing the PLC communication module to lock up and drop watchdog heartbeats.
affected_components: Johnson Controls / Frick Quantum HD Compressor Controller

title: Windows Remote Desktop Protocol Elevation of Privilege on Engineering Workstations
description: An elevation of privilege vulnerability in Windows RDP client allows local low-privileged users to execute code as SYSTEM on unpatched engineering workstations.
affected_components: Dell / Rockwell Automation Studio 5000 / TIA Portal EWS
